engine_source_evidence.observation: TSCN to SCN export repacks a fresh PackedScene and saves the resulting binary resource
Built-in resources lacking scene_unique_id receive ClassName_ plus Resource::generate_scene_unique_id() during binary serialization
generate_scene_unique_id uses clock/ticks and Math::rand() to produce a five-character identifier

observed_artifact_evidence.independent_uid_probe_result: Adding the same explicit top-level TSCN uid to independent clean exports did not eliminate PackedScene identifier drift

finding: Engine source directly explains why a generated five-character PackedScene resource identifier can vary across independent exports. This matches the observed five-byte binary difference. The exact call chain for this particular main.scn is not yet instrumented, so causality at this resource instance and full runtime semantic equivalence remain unproven.
recommended_gate_policy: Use the authenticated Factory EXE/PCK as immutable packaging authority. Treat independent re-export byte mismatch as a diagnostic, not permission to substitute a different PCK. Require exact Factory PCK hash in the actual MSIX payload and preserve independent provenance checks. Never turn normalized or scene-ID-only similarity into Store approval.
recommended_next_experiment: If strict reproducible independent export is required, instrument scene_unique_id immediately before and after SCN repack/save in an isolated Godot 4.3 debug build or controlled export plugin; do not mutate fixed Factory source or canonical PCK.
